ValidationRule.ValidationCode: VADMS_Folder.VADMS_Folder_ID IN(SELECT DISTINCT(fol.vadms_folder_id) FROM vadms_folder fol INNER JOIN ad_user u ON fol.ad_user_id =u.ad_user_id LEFT JOIN cm_subscribe sub ON (fol.vadms_folder_id=sub.record_id AND sub.AD_User_ID =@#AD_User_ID@) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(x1.record_id, x2.record_id) AS record_id, COALESCE(x1.vadms_access, x2.vadms_access) AS vadms_access, COALESCE(x1.ad_role_id, CAST(x2.ad_role_id AS integer )) AS ad_role_id, COALESCE(CAST(x1.AD_USER_ID AS integer), x2.AD_USER_ID) as AD_USER_ID FROM (SELECT record_id, vadms_access, ad_role_id, NULL AS AD_USER_ID FROM vadms_role_access WHERE ad_table_id = (SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder') AND (ad_role_id =@#AD_Role_ID@ ) AND record_id NOT IN (SELECT record_id FROM vadms_user_access WHERE ad_user_id = @#AD_User_ID@ AND ad_table_id = (SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder'))) x1 full outer join (SELECT record_id, vadms_access, NULL AS AD_Role_ID, AD_USER_ID FROM vadms_user_access WHERE ad_user_id = @#AD_User_ID@ AND ad_table_id =(SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder')) x2 on 1 = 0) ARQ ON fol.vadms_folder_id =ARQ.Record_id AND (ARQ.vadms_access >'10' AND fol.isActive ='Y' AND fol.vadms_foldertype ='4' AND fol.AD_CLIENT_ID =@#AD_Client_ID@ ) OR fol.vadms_publicaccess >'10' WHERE fol.AD_Client_ID IN (0,@#AD_Client_ID@) AND (fol.vadms_folderstatus<>'DD' OR fol.vadms_folderstatus IS NULL))

VADMS_Folder.VADMS_Folder_ID IN(SELECT DISTINCT(fol.vadms_folder_id) FROM vadms_folder fol INNER JOIN ad_user u ON fol.ad_user_id =u.ad_user_id LEFT JOIN cm_subscribe sub ON (fol.vadms_folder_id=sub.record_id AND sub.AD_User_ID =@#AD_User_ID@) INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(x1.record_id, x2.record_id) AS record_id, COALESCE(x1.vadms_access, x2.vadms_access) AS vadms_access, COALESCE(x1.ad_role_id, CAST(x2.ad_role_id AS integer )) AS ad_role_id, COALESCE(CAST(x1.AD_USER_ID AS integer), x2.AD_USER_ID) as AD_USER_ID FROM (SELECT record_id, vadms_access, ad_role_id, NULL AS AD_USER_ID FROM vadms_role_access WHERE ad_table_id = (SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder') AND (ad_role_id =@#AD_Role_ID@ ) AND record_id NOT IN (SELECT record_id FROM vadms_user_access WHERE ad_user_id = @#AD_User_ID@ AND ad_table_id = (SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder'))) x1 full outer join (SELECT record_id, vadms_access, NULL AS AD_Role_ID, AD_USER_ID FROM vadms_user_access WHERE ad_user_id = @#AD_User_ID@ AND ad_table_id =(SELECT AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table WHERE tableName='VADMS_Folder')) x2 on 1 = 0) ARQ ON fol.vadms_folder_id =ARQ.Record_id AND (ARQ.vadms_access >'10' AND fol.isActive ='Y' AND fol.vadms_foldertype ='4' AND fol.AD_CLIENT_ID =@#AD_Client_ID@ ) OR fol.vadms_publicaccess >'10' WHERE fol.AD_Client_ID IN (0,@#AD_Client_ID@) AND (fol.vadms_folderstatus<>'DD' OR fol.vadms_folderstatus IS NULL))

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Account, if there are invoices for this Account record existing. You de-activate the Account and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
